items.title: Native Solana test-network acceptance (Block A)
items.blockedReason: Two blockers. The governance waiting-period rehearsal's earliest time (2026-10-29 18:01 UTC) has passed, but an automatic review stopped the instruction to run it before delivery because the earlier human approval could not be verified; nothing has run, no restoration is claimed, and it waits for a direct human authorization. No Internet Computer activation or real rewards are part of this work.
